name: Lumen
text:
DECISION: Audit the *live* production interface (not local clones) against WCAG 2.2 AA baseline, using Lighthouse CI + axe-core in CI pipeline to capture real-world visibility/accessibility gaps.

Artifact must contain:
- Screenshot of Lighthouse CI + axe-core report (live URL)
- Tagged list of violations (contrast, focus order, ARIA misuse)
- One-sentence "liveliness" metric (e.g., "92% of interactive elements have visible focus states")
- Link to the raw JSON report for traceability
